rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical struggling and a difficult effort or fight.

example.english: We went through a long struggle to keep the shop open.
example.traditional: 我哋為咗保住間舖，經歷咗一場長期嘅掙扎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wai6 zo2 bou2 zyu6 gaan1 pou3 ging1 lik6 zo2 jat1 coeng4 coeng4 kei4 ge3 zaang6 zaat3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically, emotionally, or generally struggling.

example.english: I struggle every day just to make a living.
example.traditional: 為咗生活，我日日都要掙扎。
example.jyutping: wai4 zo2 sang1 wut6 ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zaang1 zaat3

rows.note: Use this for sustained effort toward a goal, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: We struggle for our ideals and are not afraid of repeated failure.
example.traditional: 我哋為理想奮鬥，唔怕一次又一次失敗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wai4 lei5 soeng2 fan5 dau3 m4 paa3 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 sat1 baai6

rows.note: Use this when the struggle is framed as a fight against an opponent, force, or serious problem.

example.english: They struggle desperately against a strong opponent.
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 koeng4 dik6 keoi5 ping3 ming6 bok3 dau3

rows.note: Use this for struggling because you cannot manage or cope with something.

example.english: I really struggle to cope with this report.
example.traditional: 呢份報告太長，我真係搞唔掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 taai3 coeng4 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gaau2 m4 dim6
